summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend smoke testing for BePro IELTS platform. Ran a 19-test pytest suite covering auth, entitlements, reading e2e (with server timer authority + idempotent submit + 409 on save-after-submit), listening, practice, subscription (simulated), admin CRUD, exam publish validation, exam-ID code entry, and writing AI evaluation. 18 passed, 1 skipped (quota exhaustion: seeded practice sets are ALL is_free=true so consumption never triggers - see notes). Frontend verified: home renders, student login->/app dashboard, mock tests list, exam intro rules page, exam runner with data-testid='exam-timer' (19:56 visible), question navigator, passage/questions rendered; admin login->/admin dashboard cards render, Students table lists 7 rows with STU-2026-* IDs.

minor.issue: Free practice sets never consume the practice quota (seeded practice is all is_free=true), so a free-plan student can effectively submit unlimited practice. If this is intentional (free-plan can use free-tagged items freely), it's fine — but current UI shows 'practice_remaining: 10' which is misleading. Consider only counting is_free=false submissions or clarifying the counter.
Free-tagged exams also bypass entitlement consumption; combined with above this means free-plan users are only gated by non-free content availability. If desired, keep — but document.

action_items: Consider making at least one seeded practice set is_free=false so free-plan quota exhaustion (10 practice_sets) can be exercised end-to-end.
Optional: writing AI evaluation completed within ~20-40s during our poll; keep timeouts on frontend >=45s to avoid stale 'EVALUATING' UI.
critical_code_review_comments: exam_router.get_attempt returns 'attempt' dict but on auto-expire returns {**att, 'status': 'AUTO_SUBMITTED'} without persisting the changed status on the returned copy from a re-read; harmless but slightly inconsistent.
student_router.submit_practice consumes entitlement BEFORE scoring — if scoring throws, the quota is still consumed. Wrap in try/except or consume post-scoring.
auth_router._gen_student_id uses count-based numbering (race-prone under concurrent registrations). Consider a Mongo counters collection with findOneAndUpdate($inc).
entitlements.active_subscription always falls back to ensure_free_subscription which does an insert — a benign side-effect but adds writes for every check on paid users if their sub expired.
recompute_overall exists in both exam_router and ai_router (duplicated logic). Consider moving to a shared module.

success_rate.backend: 94% (18/19; 1 skipped due to seed data, no failures)
